canon.name: Windows XD
canon.frame: a full screen view of Windows XD, a made up home computer desktop in the style of Windows XP, stretched across the whole wide 16:9 frame, the green hill wallpaper running from the far left edge to the far right edge, seen flat and straight on by a locked static camera, evenly lit
canon.still: The screen holds steady for the whole clip while soft white clouds drift slowly over the green hill and a warm startup chime rings out
canon.approach: In the first half second, {thing} lights up glossy blue and bounces
canon.arrive: {thing} bursts open {place} with a bright chime, already roaring with life
canon.settle: In the last second everything comes to rest and the screen holds steady as a clean sharp picture of the desktop, every icon and button in its place
canon.ambient: A computer fan hums softly under the desk while faint suburban birdsong drifts in from outside
canon.selectSound: A soft plastic tap from the desk
canon.lettering: crisp small Tahoma style sans in Title Case, white on blue and black on gray
canon.style: crisp widescreen 16:9 screen capture, saturated colors

ladder.mood: a perfect cozy 2003 afternoon on the family computer
peak nostalgia, every program a joyful burst
ladder.ambient: Sunlight glints across the glossy taskbar and icons
ladder.sound: A dial up modem warbles and screeches faintly in another room

ladder.mood: infected: the virus is spreading and the desktop rots
ladder.ambient: Glitch stripes flicker across the screen now and then
ladder.sound: An error ding plays again and again

ladder.mood: all out war: every program is a literal weapon against the monster
ladder.ambient: Sparks and tiny loose pixels drift across the screen
ladder.sound: A huge heroic orchestra swells under cartoon crashes

ladder.mood: the computer is fighting back and winning
ladder.ambient: The whole screen trembles with every impact
ladder.sound: A crowd of tiny voices cheers from inside the computer

ladder.mood: total victory, the desktop shines brighter than ever
ladder.ambient: The green hill gleams under a brilliant deep blue sky
ladder.sound: A triumphant fanfare plays with the startup chime

filler: Every surface is flat and front facing, like a real desktop screenshot
The wallpaper and taskbar reach the far left and far right edges of the frame
Each icon label sits just beneath its icon with a soft drop shadow
The icons are glossy and rounded with smooth bright gradients
Edges are crisp and colors are rich and saturated
The lighting is flat and even from corner to corner
All lettering is the crisp small Tahoma style sans of 2003, in Title Case
The taskbar has a smooth glossy shine with a lighter top edge
The colors are bright grass green, deep sky blue and clean white
Each icon sits on a clean patch of wallpaper with even spacing
The whole picture is sharp and steady
The screen fills the frame edge to edge with a steady exposure
Lettering is small, crisp and high contrast, with clear space around every word
The framing stays fixed on the whole screen from start to end
